name: Industrial & Energy
intro: Superworld supplies magnetic and EMC components for industrial automation, power conversion, energy management and noise filtering in connected control systems.

summary.heading: From industrial automation to efficient energy management.
summary.text: Explore component solutions supporting industrial control, connected equipment, power electronics and intelligent energy systems.

designTitle: SUPPORT RELIABLE INDUSTRIAL AND ENERGY SYSTEMS
designIntro: Enable efficient power conversion, electrical noise control and stable industrial circuit designs.

quality.manufacturing: Controlled production supports repeat component orders for industrial power and control assemblies.
quality.performance: Magnetic and EMC options support power conversion and limit switching noise around control and interface circuits.
quality.engineering: Superworld can help assess current, operating temperature and enclosure needs when selecting industrial components.

journey.identify: Choose your equipment type, from industrial robots and security systems to smart meters and lighting.
journey.review: Locate the power, motor-control or communication circuit and identify its role in the system.
journey.match: Compare series for the relevant circuit or review component guidance where selection depends on the topology.
journey.contact: Share your supply range, operating environment and circuit area with our sales team.

support: Share your equipment type, power requirements and operating environment so Superworld can help you select components.

needs.text: Provide magnetic component options for conversion stages in industrial power circuits.

needs.title: Control EMI & Switching Noise
needs.text: Support noise filtering across switching, interface and control circuits in connected equipment.

needs.title: Support Current & Thermal Requirements

needs.title: Enable Reliable Industrial Control
needs.text: Support stable power delivery and signal filtering in connected control systems.

systems.title: Industrial Robots
systems.summary: Power and EMC component candidates for robot controller boards.

modules.title: Controller Board
modules.description: The controller board coordinates motion and communication with connected equipment.
modules.need: Support stable power for low-voltage control electronics.

mappings.why: Store energy in a compatible point-of-load regulator.

modules.consultation: Share the controller power tree, peak load current and rail-voltage constraints for review.

systems.title: 3D Printers
systems.summary: Application-specific filtering and conversion review for printer interfaces, wireless, motor drives and supplies.

modules.title: Interface
modules.description: The interface carries commands and data between the printer and connected equipment.
modules.need: Reduce common-mode noise while maintaining interface bandwidth.

mappings.why: Suppress common-mode noise on a compatible differential interface.
mappings.condition: Confirm the protocol, signal bandwidth, differential insertion loss and impedance before selection.

modules.consultation: Share the interface protocol, signalling rate, cable length and emissions or immunity data for review.

modules.title: WiFi Connection
modules.description: Wi-Fi connects the printer for job transfer and remote monitoring.
modules.need: Support stable RF operation near switching and motion-control electronics.

mappings.why: Tune a compatible external Wi-Fi matching network.
mappings.condition: Select by required inductance, Q and self-resonant frequency at the radio band.

modules.consultation: Share the radio architecture, module, antenna layout and band for RF matching and supply-filter review.

modules.title: Motor Driver
modules.description: The motor driver controls the printer’s motion axes.
modules.need: Support clean power for a separate low-voltage driver supply.

mappings.why: Store energy in a compatible low-voltage supply for the motor-driver electronics.

modules.consultation: Confirm the driver supply topology, ripple, saturation behaviour, enclosure temperature and footprint.

modules.title: Power Supply
modules.description: The power supply feeds the printer’s control, motion and heating circuits.
modules.need: Support steady power across changing loads.
modules.consultation: Share input range, output loads, case temperature and insulation or protection requirements.

componentGuidance.category: Common Mode Choke / Power Converter Transformer
componentGuidance.purpose: Filter input noise or support isolated conversion where the supply topology calls for it.

systems.title: Security Products
systems.summary: Conditional component candidates for camera supply and low-voltage conversion; interface choices require design data.

modules.title: Camera Module
modules.description: The camera module captures and processes video.
modules.need: Support low-noise supply rails for the image sensor and processor.

mappings.why: Filter conducted noise on a documented low-voltage camera supply.

modules.consultation: Share the camera sensor, rail voltages and conducted noise readings to assess a supply filter.

modules.title: DC-DC Converter
modules.description: The converter supplies regulated power to cameras, radios and controls.
modules.need: Support efficient local conversion across the expected loads.

mappings.why: Store energy in a compatible low-voltage switching regulator.

modules.consultation: Share the input and output range, switch frequency, load profile and inductor dimensions.

modules.title: WiFi
modules.description: Wi-Fi carries video and control data over the network.
modules.need: Support a stable wireless link near digital and power circuits.

mappings.why: Tune a compatible external Wi-Fi matching network.
mappings.condition: Select by required inductance, Q and self-resonant frequency at the radio band.

modules.consultation: Share the radio, operating band and PCB layout to assess the supply and external matching requirements.

modules.title: USB / HDMI
modules.description: USB and HDMI carry high-speed data over differential links.
modules.need: Reduce common-mode noise while preserving signal integrity.

mappings.why: Suppress common-mode noise on a compatible differential pair.
mappings.condition: Check the USB or HDMI generation and verify signal integrity against the link requirements.

modules.consultation: Provide the USB or HDMI generation, topology and measured signal integrity so the interface filter can be reviewed.

systems.title: Smart Meter
systems.summary: Engineering review for mains-connected power blocks, measurement and wireless communications.

modules.title: Power Supply Circuit
modules.description: The supply powers metrology, processing and communications.
modules.need: Support a stable supply for measurement and communication loads.

mappings.why: Store energy in a separate low-voltage switching regulator.
mappings.condition: Check current, saturation, temperature rise and height against the regulator and enclosure.

modules.consultation: Provide the meter supply architecture, metrology isolation requirements and communications load.

modules.title: AC-DC Converter
modules.description: The AC-DC stage produces the meter’s regulated supply from line power.
modules.need: Support the selected conversion and isolation architecture.
modules.consultation: Share the converter topology, working voltage, surge conditions, insulation and thermal limits for review.

componentGuidance.purpose: Transfer power across the isolation barrier in an isolated converter.

modules.title: Wireless Module
modules.description: The wireless module transmits meter readings to the network.
modules.need: Support a stable radio link and modem power during transmission.

mappings.why: Tune a compatible external radio matching network.
mappings.condition: Select by the modem band, required inductance, Q and self-resonant frequency.

modules.consultation: Share the modem, frequency bands and antenna network to define the power and RF filtering roles.

systems.title: LED Lighting
systems.summary: Review mains and converter stages against the actual power topology and applicable safety requirements.

modules.title: AC Power
modules.description: The AC input supplies line power to the LED driver.
modules.need: Support noise filtering in the line-side input network.
modules.consultation: Share the luminaire input range, surge requirements, protection architecture and available board space.

componentGuidance.purpose: Filter common-mode noise where the AC input uses a suitable mains-rated choke.

modules.title: AC-DC Converter
modules.description: The driver converts AC power into regulated current for the LEDs.
modules.need: Support stable LED current within the driver and isolation architecture.
modules.consultation: Share the LED string voltage and current, conversion topology, thermal limits and isolation requirements.

componentGuidance.purpose: Transfer power in an isolated driver designed for the LED load.
